    latest_start = max(start1, start2)
    earliest_end = min(end1, end2)
    delta = (earliest_end - latest_start).seconds / 60
    return delta if delta > 0 else 0

    start = parse_time(meetings[person]['start'])
    end = parse_time(meetings[person]['end'])
    min_duration = meetings[person]['min_duration']
    
    # Find the longest possible meeting within the available window
    best_start = None
    best_end = None
    best_overlap = 0
    
    for t in range((start - current_time).seconds // 60, (end - current_time).seconds // 60 + 1):
        test_start = current_time + timedelta(minutes=t)
        test_end = test_start + timedelta(minutes=min_duration)
        if test_end <= end:
            current_overlap = overlap(test_start, test_end, start, end)
            if current_overlap > best_overlap:
                best_overlap = current_overlap
                best_start = test_start
                best_end = test_end
    
    return best_start, best_end

    current_time = parse_time('9:00')

                    'end_time': best_end.strftime('%H:%M')
                })
                current_time = best_end
                locations_visited.add(location)
